# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.8.3

Version 1.8.3 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.8.2

**The Pocket Camp style answers on the original disc too.** Held upright in the full touch mode, the answers are big
buttons at the bottom; until now only with the Korean patch, as the port could not write out the original disc's
Japanese, and the game's own answer window was moved to the bottom instead. Now the buttons are there on the original
disc as well, in Japanese:

- The original disc's characters are read as the game's font reads them: its kana and signs, and the kanji of its two
  kanji pages, which a string reaches through kanji and ruby tags (a kanji shows as itself when the player's kanji
  level allows it, else as its reading in kana, as in the game's own window). The table comes from the decomp's names
  for every code of the game's font.
- The menus' font had no kana or kanji (NanumGothic: Hangul and Latin). The kana and kanji come from M PLUS Rounded 1c
  (SIL Open Font License 1.1), cut down to the characters the game's font has and merged into the menu font, sized to
  match it: rounded, as the buttons are.

- The release files carry the new font's license (`licenses/menu_font_jp_OFL.txt`).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.8.2's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.3-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.3-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.3-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.3-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Held upright (720x1560) on the original disc, by script: the title's talk showed its three answers as buttons
  (はーい! / あそぶじゅんび / ほかのこと) the size of the Korean ones; a tap on the second picked it.
- With the Korean patch, a villager's two answers as before (그냥 심심풀이 / 볼일은 없어요); a tap on the second
  picked it.
- Kanji and ruby: a string built as the game builds them, with a kanji tag of level 0 and one of level 9 around a ruby
  (reading かう, kanji 予), read on a player of kanji level 0: か予! and かかう!, as the game's own font shows them.
- Every character of the game's font is in the menu fonts, but five weather and letter icons that no menu font has
  (left out of the text).
- Landscape: unchanged. The fifteen touch checks run on v1.8.2's release and on this version log the same and give the
  same screenshots (the menu font with the Japanese merged in draws the Korean and the icons as before).
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.7.0 and
  on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; CI also checks the Japanese table against the decomp's charmap.h. No decomp change.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.8.3, versionCode 10803).

## Known limitations

- Held upright, the buildings and villagers of acres two or more away are not shown.
- The upright layout was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.8.2 remain (see the [v1.8.2 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.8.2)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
